title: Available: 2 different AW smartwatches to donate to a developer willing to work on "Force collector" problems
symptom: The user could not get either the Fossil Q Founder 2.0 or the Polar M600 to work under force collector mode in the latest alpha channel release of xdrip+.
fix: A firmware patch was produced for the Polar M600 and Asus Zenwatch3 to make them work with the G5.
evidence_quote: I have just produced a firmware patch for the Zenwatch 2 to get it to work so a similar strategy may be possible with these watches as well.
